items.summary: Recommendation: preserve containment-only execution. The brief supports a deferred, evidence-backed portfolio backlog across SEO, UX, accessibility, performance, content depth, internal linking, affiliate attribution, and reusable site capabilities. Prioritize opportunities by user benefit, attributable outcome, confidence, time-to-learn, and reversibility after existing failures are repaired or closed and measurement capacity is available. Current evidence shows 103 SEO actions across 39 sites, 47 failure follow-ups, 28 deployed improvements awaiting measurement, and only 2 proven outcomes. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: $4.92 aggregate commission with no site-attributed commission; ROI, margin, and causal lift remain unknown. Do not create new production work, requeues, experiments, duplicate telemetry, dependencies, spend, monetization expansion, or unsupported claims this cycle. Continue only existing repair-or-close, measurement/attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only evidence work.
